result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel sits lower than its neighbors, and the favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between cards.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is shifted about 28px lower than the 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccola' cards. Its image, time badge, title and delivery fee all sit below the other cards, so the row looks jagged.
issues.suggestion: Top-align all carousel items, for example with align-items: flex-start and consistent margins. Remove any extra top margin or padding on the second card.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) button looks different on each card. On 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' it is a bare white outline with no background. On the pizza card below it sits inside a dark translucent circle.
issues.suggestion: Use one favorite-button style on all cards, ideally the circular background version, which keeps the icon visible on any image.
